question: What indications does Acetylsalicylic acid have?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Acetylsalicylic acid'})-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) RETURN ind.name ORDER BY ind.name LIMIT 10

question: How many drugs have indications related to Diabetes?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) WHERE ind.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS drug_count

What is the full drug landscape for the CYP2D6 gene — all drugs and interaction types?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[i:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene {gene_name: 'CYP2D6'}) RETURN d.name, i.interaction_type ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 10
